summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K containing routine unaudited operating statistics for Q2 and H1 2026, including gold production, sales, and cost metrics. The filing discloses that Serra Grande was sold on 1 December 2025, referencing a completed divestiture but not announcing it. No new special-situation transaction, strategic review, or corporate action is being initiated. The document is an ordinary operational update under Rule 13a-16, not a special-situation event. As such, it does not warrant classification under any listed category.
